source_text: Its preamble invokes prior anti-mutilation statements from symposia, humanist groups, and World Health Organization resolutions targeting harmful traditions, asserting that all forms of child genital modification inflict irreversible physical and psychological harm without consent or medical necessity, thereby breaching children's rights to bodily integrity, health, and protection from abuse.
